name: Inshoku no Mahou Shoujo Tentacle!! ~Hana Chirasu Mahou Shoujo Nemeratia Toujou Hen
original_name: 淫触の魔法少女テンタクル！！～華散らす魔法少女ネメラティーア登場編
source:
Azusa Nagano is an idol and a defender of justice against tentacles.
When her manager gives her a week vacation, she goes home
to relax, hoping to spend time with her girlfriend Saki.
But both girls are being watched by a lustful creature...
and it has targeted Saki to plunder the darkness of her heart!

Seized!!!... in disgraceful tentacle pleasure!!

translation:
永野梓既是一名偶像，也是對抗觸手、捍衛正義的戰士。
經紀人讓她放一個星期的假，她回到家中放鬆，希望能和女友沙希共度時光。
然而，一個淫慾旺盛的生物正暗中監視兩個女孩……
它盯上了沙希，準備掠奪她心底的黑暗！

被抓住了！！！……沉溺於屈辱的觸手快感之中！！
